item.title: South African United Rugby Championship sides sweep weekend with bonus-point victories
item.description: South Africa’s URC franchises dominated the weekend, with Bulls, Lions, Stormers, and Sharks claiming bonus-point victories. The wins strengthened top-eight positions and kept play-off hopes alive ahead of five remaining pool matches.

item.title: A 30-minute act that saves lives: SANBS urges South Africans to donate blood this Easter
item.description: The South African National Blood Service calls on South Africans to donate blood on 28 March, aiming to collect 6,000 units in one day as Easter travel pressures national blood supplies.

item.title: Afrika satisfied as Bok Women secure World Championship spot
item.description: The Springbok Women’s Sevens secured World Championship qualification after a third-place finish in Montevideo, with coach Cecil Afrika praising their overall performance while highlighting key improvements needed ahead of the final tournament in São Paulo.

item.title: Van der Bergh and Mathewson retain Northern Cape Open Singles crowns
item.description: Defending champions Marietjie van der Bergh and CP Mathewson successfully retained their Northern Cape Open singles titles in Kimberley, capping a competitive tournament that showcased depth, consistency, and high-quality performances across both divisions.

item.title: Nhlanhla Ndlovu steps off stage to inspire with story of risk and purpose
item.description: Nhlanhla Ndlovu reflects on his journey from engineering graduate to Lion King performer, releasing new music and launching a motivational tour focused on purpose, resilience and change.

item.title: Northern Cape pitches itself as key investment hub ahead of 2026 conference
item.description: Northern Cape readies to attract global investors, highlighting mining, agriculture, renewable energy, and infrastructure opportunities ahead of the Northern Cape Investment and Jobs Conference 2026 in Kimberley, April 13–15.

item.title: Janco Uys: Built for the battle in the Griquas pack
item.description: Janco Uys has grown into a reliable hooker for the Suzuki Griquas, combining resilience, discipline, and consistency. From early promise to overcoming injury setbacks, he continues to anchor the pack with leadership, toughness, and quiet determination.

item.title: From intern to engineer: Mentorship and skills launch local graduate into engineering career
item.description: Grosjean Van Wyk’s SAWEA internship at Kangnas Wind Farm helped her transition from graduate to Junior Electrical Technician, highlighting mentorship, practical skills, and career growth in South Africa’s renewable energy sector.

item.title: Eskom Expo for Young Scientists District Expos begin across Northern Cape
item.description: The Eskom Expo for Young Scientists is set to enhance learner participation and research quality through District Expos across the Northern Cape, paving the way for future scientific innovation.

item.title: South Africa lays Khoisan remains to rest in Northern Cape ceremony
item.description: South Africa reburies 63 Khoisan remains in Steinkopf following repatriation from museums, with leaders describing the ceremony as a step towards restoring dignity and addressing a painful past.
